model: finite product-simplex conditional labels; bounded [0,1] safety costs
grid_construction: finite_cases.bounded_grid: 3 class counts x 4 mass vectors x 5 operator types; pattern (K + operator_index) modulo 5; two candidates per grid problem
empty_fiber_rule: ProtocolFailure; never ADAPT, FREEZE, or an empty-set safety certificate
single_candidate_action_rule: ADAPT only if minimum benefit >0; FREEZE only if maximum benefit <0; otherwise ABSTAIN
multi_candidate_scope: Frozen-versus-candidate bounds checked separately; no simultaneous statistical controller or strict multiadapter selection is implemented
certificates: Both primal and dual witnesses required for every emitted exact minimum and maximum; independent checker recomputes costs, constraints, bounds, and action
theorem_authority: Lean only; this protocol cannot promote a theorem
